text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing shopping with Mihono 
Bourbon, we were walking in front of the 
station when...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Urrrgh, what am I gonna dooo~...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Familiar voice confirmed. Memory search 
result: Identified as Falcon-san.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Is something the matter, Falcon-san? Are 
you having some trouble?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh! Bourbon-chan! Hey, hey, wanna do an 
Umadol☆Live together!?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It's an abbreviation for 'Uma Musume Idol 
Live.' I heard before that you were 
holding solo lives in front of the 
station.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Right, right! So, I wanna change up the 
concert setlist~ I've been thinking... I 
really want to try something totally new!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Bourbon-chan! How about a guest 
appearance?! It'll be good practice for 
the Winning Live too♪
choice_data_list: Shall we try taking on the challenge?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. We have plenty of energy remaining. 
Execution is possible.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Master. Is there anything I should keep in 
mind regarding my guest appearance?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In this cutthroat idol era, what matters 
most must be having a unique individuality 
like no other...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Showing off your power might be good 
too! Like using your toned muscles to 
dance coolly!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Order acknowledged. Calculating method to 
apply my muscular strength to dance...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Calculations complete. I shall use the 
grip-strength training walnuts purchased 
earlier.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? Walnuts... Huh, walnuts?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A poppy idol song plays in front of the 
station. In time with the rhythm, Mihono 
Bourbon crushes walnuts—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Snap♪ Crack♪ Crack♪ Snap, crack♪)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
N-No way…… She's cracking walnuts to the 
beat of the music!?
choice_data_list:
I-I never expected it would turn out like 
this...!

text_block_list.name: Regulars
text_block_list.text:
She's today's live concert guest!? That's 
way too awesome! I gotta record this!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
And the regulars are raving about it!? 
...Bourbon, what a terrifying girl...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
All riiight! Falco's gonna give it her all 
too! I'll show you the power of the 
original Umadol☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Whew, thank you, Bourbon-chan! The live 
show was a success! Falco got super pumped 
up too!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
An Umadol☆Live that doesn't just serve as 
a Winning Live, but also builds physical 
strength... How fascinating.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The unique performance was a huge 
success, making the guest appearance an 
event full of valuable lessons!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In this cutthroat idol era, what matters 
most is how you can run a live 
performance...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Y-You're right! As idols, we should be 
handling enough songs for a dome concert, 
right!?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Understood. I will keep dancing with all 
my might.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
All righty! Then our new live setlist will 
be the "Umadol Non-Stop Live 
Extravaganza"!

text_block_list.name: Regular Young Man
text_block_list.text:
Even on the 10th song, her dancing hasn't 
slipped at all?! Th-This is 
unbelievable...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I am an Umamusume... no, an 
Umadol, after all.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
That's right! We're just getting started! 
Alright, here comes song number eleven!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm completely exhausted~~~... but... 
the concert was a huge success... Thank 
you both so much!
choice_data_list: Great job on the long concert!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"35 songs, including the requests. I 
danced my heart out through every single 
one."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I mean, Bourbon-chan is amazing, isn't 
she?! She's not even out of breath...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It is because Master has been training me. 
Regardless... it was good training.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
An Umadol☆Live that not only serves as a 
Winning Live, but also builds stamina... 
How intriguing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The energetic live performance was a 
massive success, making for a guest 
appearance full of valuable lessons!
